name: pending-actions-digest
description: Send a daily digest of open approval requests and the task backlog awaiting CEO attention.

outputs.pending: number — count of open approval requests included in digest
outputs.skipped: boolean — true if digest was not sent (nothing to show, or CEO_PRIMARY_EMAIL / outboundGateway not configured)
outputs.tasksForCeo: number — open/in_progress tasks owned by the CEO
outputs.tasksWorking: number — open/in_progress tasks owned by Curia
